advertiserResponsibilities: Provide final approved high-resolution vector artwork and brand guidelines prior to production cutoff.
Maintain active contact availability for production proofs and digital sample sign-off.
Acknowledge that campaign cancellation is permitted strictly prior to production start.
Comply with AquaBloom commercial payment schedule upon final order pricing confirmation.
venueResponsibilities: Maintain dedicated, clean, ambient storage capacity for the agreed campaign bottle volume.
Position bottles exclusively within agreed venue placement staging areas.
Ensure bottles are offered complimentary to verified venue visitors during the campaign window.
Refrain from reselling, redirecting, or tampering with campaign inventory.
aquaBloomResponsibilities: Coordinate and oversee verified packaging supplier production and quality compliance.
Manage regional freight logistics from manufacturing facility to venue loading dock.
Provide real-time digital QR engagement tracking and verified distribution reporting.
Facilitate secure settlement and commercial disbursement between all participating stakeholders.

cancellationTerms.termsSummary: Advertiser or Venue may cancel without penalty strictly BEFORE manufacturing production commences.

cancellationTerms.nonRecoverableCostPrinciple: Once raw materials are committed and production begins, cancellations are non-recoverable and will be handled exclusively under Recovery & Resolution procedures.

renewalTerms.termsSummary: This Campaign Agreement does not automatically renew. Extension or subsequent run requires explicit mutual agreement and a new agreement document.

terms.customConditions: Premium placement in VIP reception area
importantConditions: Mutual commercial lock takes legal effect upon atomic confirmation by both authorized parties.
Neither party may unilaterally alter agreed quantities, delivery staging, or venue allocations following lock.
Any post-lock adjustments must be processed through formal platform governance and resolution protocols.

Manage regional freight logistics from manufacturing facility to venue loading dock.
Provide real-time digital QR engagement tracking and verified distribution reporting.
Facilitate secure settlement and commercial disbursement between all participating stakeholders.
